Game Overview

In Pencil Rush Online, the core idea is straightforward: race through vibrant worlds in Pencil Rush Online, where your creativity reigns supreme. Collect dazzling pencils and customize their effects, trails, and colors. Whether you're a fiery graphite missile or a whimsical crayon, your unique style creates a legendary path. How will your artistic journey unfold?
